site.name: Alloy Studios
site.tagline: A small team making fast browser games.

roadmap.title: Two more games
roadmap.detail: Two new titles are in the works. Same rules as everything else here: single page, no install, playable the second the link loads.

roadmap.title: A full rework of every game
roadmap.detail: Once those ship, every game in the catalogue gets rebuilt - better feel, better visuals, and a consistent standard across the whole library rather than sixteen different ones.

site.intro: Alloy Studios makes small, fast browser games - roguelites, sandboxes, tower defense, idle games and whatever else is worth trying next. Everything runs instantly in a tab, with nothing to download and nothing to install.
about: Every game here is built as a single self-contained page. That is a deliberate constraint: no engine to load, no asset packs to download, no launcher. You click a link and you are playing inside a second or two, on a phone or a laptop, and it still works years later because there is nothing to rot.
It is a small operation. One developer builds the games, one steers what gets made next and keeps the ideas coming, and one plays everything to destruction before it goes live.
The catalogue moves fast and openly. Games ship in beta, get rebuilt, and sometimes get pulled. Each one's source lives on GitHub, so what you play is exactly what is in the repo.

games.title: Neon Survivor Legends
games.tagline: Survive the swarm, fuse legendary powers.
games.description: Level seven base weapons to max and fuse them in pairs. Hold exactly three Fusions at once to unlock a Super Fusion. Endless roguelite survival against a swarm that never stops growing.
games.controls: WASD or arrows to move, Space to dash, 1-3 to pick

games.title: Rivalforge
games.tagline: Chain clean hits in the calibration bay.
games.description: Wave after wave in Calibration Bay 04. Every clean hit builds your chain multiplier and every miss resets it, so the score comes from accuracy rather than volume.
games.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim, Shift to dash, 1-3 to switch

games.title: Port Vesper
games.tagline: Eighteen square blocks of bad decisions.
games.description: An open-city sandbox: drive, shoot, jack cars, rob shops and outrun the police. The law only knows what it sees, so break line of sight and they search your last known position instead of you.
games.controls: WASD to move or drive, mouse to aim, E to enter a car, R to rob, Space to handbrake

games.title: Blox Fruits 2D
games.tagline: Pirate cay, ten fruits, four swords.
games.description: A 2D take on the pirate island grind. Take bounties from Hunter Marco, fight bandits along the cay, and swap between fruit and sword loadouts mid-fight. This is the beta build, so everything is unlocked for testing.
games.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim, Z X C V F for moves, Shift to dash, Tab for inventory

games.title: Blue Lock Rivals: Ego Arena
games.tagline: Three hundred strikers. One goal.
games.description: A single-file football game and fan tribute. Devour the ball, devour your rivals, and become the world's greatest egoist across two-minute matches. The pitch, the strikers, the cut-in cutscenes, the crowd and every sound effect are generated at runtime.
games.controls: WASD to move, Shift to dash, J to shoot, K to pass, L to tackle

games.title: Solo Leveling: Arise
games.tagline: Allocate your points. Clear the dungeon.
games.description: A System-driven progression RPG. Raise strength, agility, vitality, perception and intelligence, choose a class, kit out your inventory, and push deeper into the dungeons. Beta build, still changing.
games.controls: Mouse to navigate, Space and Esc

games.title: Echoes
games.tagline: Recovered audio. Do not play alone.
games.description: A horror game in three recovered tracks, where sound carries the information rather than decorating it. Headphones strongly recommended, and the warning on the title screen is not decoration either.
games.controls: Mouse. Headphones strongly recommended

games.title: Anime Survivors
games.tagline: Awaken your weapons, then go further.
games.description: Bullet-heaven survival, visually remastered. Reach level 5 to awaken your weapons and level 10 to unleash their true ultimate forms, with anomaly bosses breaking in as you climb.
games.controls: WASD or arrows to move, touch and drag on mobile

games.title: Aura Fighters
games.tagline: Charge your ki. Transform. Clear the wave.
games.description: Wave-based arena brawling with a power level that never stops climbing. Charge ki, fire blasts, trigger specials, and transform once the gauge fills, taking a Zenkai boost every time a wave falls.
games.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim, Q to dash, 1 ki blast, 2 special, hold C to charge, T to transform

games.title: Neon Defense Grid
games.tagline: Six towers against the incursion.
games.description: Tower defense on a neon grid. Build pulse blasters, void spitters, arc emitters, artillery nodes, hive drones and rail-spires, then deconstruct and rebuild as the incursion escalates and your system integrity drains.
games.controls: Mouse to place and upgrade towers

games.title: Foil & Fortune
games.tagline: Run the card shop floor.
games.description: Card shop management. Order cartons from the wholesale catalog, shelve and price them, scan customers through the till, and keep reputation and cleanliness up as the queue grows. Better sets stay locked behind licences.
games.controls: WASD to move around the shop, click to interact

games.title: Abyssal Dredging
games.tagline: Idle salvage from the trench.
games.description: Drop nets into the abyss, haul up specimens and scrap, then spend it on high-torque motors, phosphor lures and heavier nets to pull more per trip. Runs itself once the automation is assembled.
games.controls: Mouse / touch

games.title: Neon Speed Simulator
games.tagline: Gather speed, unlock skins and trails.
games.description: Build up raw speed, spend it on upgrades, and unlock skins with trails in the hangar. Sign in to keep your progress across sessions, or jump straight in as a guest.
games.controls: Mouse / touch

games.title: Cosmic Climb
games.tagline: 3,000 metres to the centre of the universe.
games.description: Climb from the sky through the stratosphere, deep space and nebulas to reach the Center of the Universe, three thousand meters up, one jump at a time.
games.controls: A/D or arrows to move, W, Up or Space to jump

games.title: Orbit Dash
games.tagline: One button. Infinite orbits.
games.description: One button, two orbits, and debris coming the other way. Tap to swap rings, thread the gaps, and watch the whole thing speed up under you. Your best run is saved locally.
games.controls: Click / Space to jump orbit

games.title: Alloy Mind
games.tagline: Turn the boring PDF into a game.
games.description: Feed it the PDF your teacher posted - or a Word doc, slides, a sheet, a link, or raw pasted text - and it comes back as questions. Five game modes, coins to earn, packs to pull, and fifty-five collectibles to chase. Bring your own Claude API key and the questions get noticeably smarter.
games.controls: Mouse. Forge a set, then pick between answer choices

games.title: Multiverse Fighters
games.tagline: Twelve fighters. Twelve realms. One ring.
games.description: A 2D fighter with twelve characters pulled from twelve different realms - shinobi, soul reapers, machines, Olympians, cartoons - each with their own normals, specials and an ultimate. Learn a moveset in the training grounds, then take it into a fight.
games.controls: A/D move, Space jump, W/S aim, Shift dash, J and K attack, L special, U ultimate

games.title: Flytale
games.tagline: A short story, told by a fly.
games.description: A chaptered story game where you play the fly - flying, dodging, and staying well clear of the flyswatter. Small, hand-made and over before it outstays its welcome.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD to fly, Z to confirm, X to cancel, M to mute

games.title: Madballs
games.tagline: Physics, destruction, loot.
games.description: Drag the slingshot, let go, and wreck the level. Fourteen stages, crates to crack open, and thirty-seven skins to hunt down - each with its own ability you trigger mid-flight for a second shot at the wreckage.
games.controls: Drag from the slingshot to fire, Space or click mid-flight for your skin's ability

games.title: Elementalis
games.tagline: Wizard of the Broken Wilds.
games.description: The old magic shattered into elements and scattered across the wilds. Find the shrines, slay their wardens, and take the power back. Master elements in the Grimoire and fuse them into new ones as you go.
games.controls: WASD move, mouse aim, click to cast, 1-4 spell slots, Shift to blink, E to commune, C for the Grimoire

games.title: Sole & Co.
games.tagline: Grandma left you the shop. Don't blow it.
games.description: You inherited a two-metre-wide sneaker shop, three pairs and $1,500. Stock the shelves, read the day's heat, work the market and the customs bench, and make rent before the doors close. Deadstock, customs, trade.
games.controls: Mouse to stock, price and serve
